description: Different model profiles should preserve inferred package-boundary placement recommendations when app-owned tests cover package-owned source paths.

lockedFields.reason: Unit-level package-owned behavior covered by an app-owned test should be a move recommendation, not split.
The current app-level test owner must remain visible for review.
The package-like source owner should be preserved as the suggested owner.
The report should expose the repo-relative app-owned test path.
Inferred placement finding IDs should remain stable for downstream review links.

lockedFields.expected: package boundary inferred from project roots: package-like source owner covered by app-like test owner
lockedFields.reason: The finding should explain that the package boundary came from conservative project-root inference.

unexpectedVariations: inferred package boundary hidden from placement findings
unit-level package behavior upgraded to split without app integration evidence
missing current or suggested project owner
